summary: Affection or comfort loses its tax when you stop instantly calculating how you're going to pay the universe back for it.
body: Affection or comfort loses its tax when you stop instantly calculating how you're going to pay the universe back for it. When the Moon sextiles Venus, emotional ease and connection cooperate, letting you actually receive support, kindness, or pleasure without immediately converting it into a debt. Something gets to feel good simply because it feels good; you don't have to earn your way into a moment of grace. Let yourself accept the ease without looking for the hidden bill.
